provenance: Original synthetic journal-style examples authored for this project, not private journals or human-validated data. Training/development examples are separate from regression fixtures.

examples.text: The bus ride home felt lighter after finally finishing the project.
I keep smiling when I remember the little celebration we had at dinner.
Seeing my old friends brought warmth to an otherwise ordinary afternoon.
I felt proud of myself for trying something unfamiliar today.
Tonight I am grateful for the people who showed up for me.
I feel relieved that the test is over and excited about the weekend.
The quiet apartment feels empty without my old roommate here.
I miss those evenings together and the loss keeps catching up with me.
I cried in the car on the way home from saying goodbye.
I felt lonely sitting with everyone at lunch today.
Tonight I am heartbroken about how our conversation ended.
I feel disappointed in how the meeting turned out.
Being interrupted again made me want to slam the door.
The unfair way I was treated at work has been eating at me all evening.
I resent having to clean up the same mess again after being ignored.
I felt furious when my boundaries were dismissed today.
Tonight I am irritated by the constant demands on my time.
I feel frustrated about being blamed for something I did not do.
My thoughts keep racing through everything that could go wrong at the appointment.
The uncertainty about the exam kept me awake most of the night.
My hands were shaking before I walked into the interview room.
I felt terrified when I heard someone outside my door.
Tonight I am anxious about the results arriving tomorrow.
I feel nervous about starting somewhere new next week.
The rotten food in the fridge made my stomach turn.
The smell from the dirty bin made me recoil and step outside.
I cannot get the sight of that filthy kitchen out of my head.
I felt repulsed by the cruel joke at dinner.
Tonight I am disgusted by how the animals were treated.
I feel sickened after seeing what was left in the sink.
The unexpected visit left me standing speechless in the doorway.
I never saw that announcement coming and needed a moment to take it in.
The sudden change of plans caught me completely off guard.
I felt astonished when the letter arrived this morning.
Tonight I am amazed by the news I received.
I feel surprised that the event was canceled without warning.
I took the train to the office and brought lunch from home.
The appointment starts at nine and the shop closes at six.
I put the notebook on the desk beside the window.
My shopping list contains bread and milk.
I moved the laundry into the cupboard this afternoon.
I checked the calendar and wrote down the meeting time.
